text: Implemented scale descriptors and diagnostic mapping failures in Scales.scala, plus compiler-level scale declarations/trained descriptors and typed row-drop reasons for transform-domain and scale out-of-domain failures. Added tests for descriptor metadata, log10 zero/negative drops, discrete unknown-level drops, and clean JVM/JS behavior. Verified: sbt graphicsJVM/test graphicsJS/test graphicsSvgJVM/test graphicsSvgJS/test.
